about_the_game:
"Witch Pachi" is a deck-building roguelike that merges strategic card play with physics-driven combat mechanics, taking inspiration from the progression style of Slay the Spire.

In this game, the player takes on the role of a witch who builds a deck using mana elements and skills that harness their power.

The core combat revolves around dropping orbs onto the battlefield to collect elemental resources. Each skill in a witch’s deck has specific elemental requirements, and once these are met by gathering enough of the corresponding elements from dropped orbs, the skill is automatically cast, unleashing its effects.

The gameplay follows a roguelike structure with procedurally generated paths, featuring battles, events, and opportunities to enhance decks. Each run challenges players to adapt their strategies, leveraging the interplay between deck composition and orb physics.

Currently in development, "Witch Pachi" aims to deliver a fresh take on the genre with its innovative casting system.

More details will emerge as development progresses!
